description: This is a statewide competitive programming contest designed to bring together talented students from colleges and universities across Bihar. The competition aims to promote problem-solving, algorithmic thinking, competitive programming, and collaboration within Bihar's growing technology community. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced competitive programmer, this contest provides an opportunity to challenge yourself and compete with students from across the state. Eligibility Open to students enrolled in colleges and universities across Bihar. Students from all branches and academic years are eligible. Participation is individual. Registration is free. Both beginners and experienced programmers are welcome. Contest Format Mode: Online Duration: 120 minutes Number of problems: 6 Difficulty: Easy to Hard Topics: Data Structures, Algorithms, and Problem Solving Evaluation: Automated test-case-based evaluation Rules and Guidelines Participants must solve all problems independently. The use of AI tools, external solutions, or assistance from other individuals is strictly prohibited. Sharing solutions during the contest is not allowed. Participants must register using accurate personal and academic information. Multiple accounts and impersonation are prohibited. Participants must follow all applicable contest security and proctoring instructions. Plagiarism or verified unfair practices may result in disqualification. Final rankings will be published after submission verification. Evaluation Criteria Participants will be evaluated based on solution correctness, test cases passed, and the applicable contest scoring and tiebreaking rules. Our Vision To build a stronger competitive programming culture across Bihar by connecting students, encouraging technical excellence, and providing a common platform to showcase their problem-solving abilities. Think. Code. Compete. Grow.
organiser: Rastrakavi Ramdhari Singh Dinkar College of Engineering(RRSDCE), Begusarai
